title: Entering the Mirror Part 2
speaker: Kanho Chris Burkhart and Seiu Hannah Sullivan
summary: The talk's main teaching emphasizes the importance of taking action in the present moment to awaken, rather than waiting for a perfected self. This involves letting go of intellectual thinking and embracing reality as it is, without trying to improve or escape it. By doing so, we can find awakening in every moment, not just in special circumstances, and live a whole and authentic life that is free from hypocrisy and division between our words and actions.
